records.sql: WITH shelved_metadata AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(metadata_key) OVER (ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid) = metadata_key THEN NULL ELSE metadata_key END AS metadata_key, instance_uuid, display_name, power_state, metadata_value, network_info, window_column, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS total_rows_per_key, AVG(power_state) OVER (PARTITION BY metadata_key) AS avg_power_state_per_key FROM inner_cte ORDER BY metadata_key, instance_uuid), top_memory_range_display_names AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(i.memory_mb) - MIN(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instances` AS i2 JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic2 ON i2.uuid = ic2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0 AND ic2.deleted = 0 AND i2.display_name = inner_cte.display_name) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_info_cache FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb_range DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid, sm.display_name, sm.power_state, sm.metadata_value, sm.network_info, sm.window_column, sm.total_rows_per_key, sm.avg_power_state_per_key, tmr.display_name AS top10_display_name, tmr.memory_mb_range, tmr.memory_mb_variance, tmr.memory_mb_stddev, tmr.has_active_info_cache FROM shelved_metadata AS sm JOIN top_memory_range_display_names AS tmr ON sm.display_name = tmr.display_name ORDER BY tmr.memory_mb_range DESC, sm.metadata_key, sm.instance_uuid

WITH vm_state_migration_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, EXP(AVG(LN(m.memory_total))) AS geometric_mean_memory_total FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE m.memory_total > 0 AND c.network_info <> '' GROUP BY i.vm_state ORDER BY geometric_mean_memory_total DESC), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_memory_total) AS benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.vm_state, ic.geometric_mean_memory_total, b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_total > b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_MIGRATION' WHEN ic.geometric_mean_memory_total < b.benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_MIGRATION' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MIGRATION' END AS migration_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_memory_total DESC), confirmed_ether60_migrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID AS instance_uuid, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS dest_compute, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.VM_STATE AS instance_vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.STATUS ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'confirmed' AND m.SOURCE_COMPUTE = 'ether-60') SELECT inner_cte.migration_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.source_compute, inner_cte.dest_compute, inner_cte.instance_display_name, inner_cte.instance_vm_state, inner_cte.instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.window_column, i.project_id AS project_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error') AND m2.id <> inner_cte.migration_id) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS project_has_other_active_migrations FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON inner_cte.instance_uuid = i.uuid ORDER BY inner_cte.migration_status, inner_cte.migration_id) SELECT cem.migration_id, cem.instance_uuid, cem.migration_status, cem.source_compute, cem.dest_compute, cem.instance_display_name, cem.instance_vm_state, cem.instance_memory_mb, cem.window_column, cem.project_id, cem.project_has_other_active_migrations, vms.geometric_mean_memory_total AS vm_state_geometric_mean_memory_total, vms.benchmark AS vm_state_benchmark_geometric_mean_memory_total, vms.migration_category AS vm_state_migration_category FROM confirmed_ether60_migrations AS cem LEFT JOIN vm_state_migration_stats AS vms ON cem.instance_vm_state = vms.vm_state ORDER BY cem.migration_status, cem.migration_id

WITH q1_inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), q1 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(display_name) OVER (ORDER BY memory_mb, instance_uuid) = display_name THEN NULL ELSE display_name END AS display_name, instance_uuid, vm_state, memory_mb, vcpus, instance_extra_id, instance_extra_created_at, network_info, window_column FROM q1_inner_cte ORDER BY memory_mb, instance_uuid), q2_inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.UUID, t0.HOSTNAME, t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, t2.NETWORK_INFO, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY t0.ID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS t0 JOIN `instance_extra` AS t1 ON t1.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t2.INSTANCE_UUID = t0.UUID WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), q2_avg_ids AS (SELECT AVG(t0.ID) AS avg_instance_id FROM `instances` AS t0 WHERE t0.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), q2 AS (SELECT i.UUID, i.HOSTNAME, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, i.NETWORK_INFO, i.window_column AS rank_within_az_by_id, (t0.ID - a.avg_instance_id) AS deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM q2_inner_cte AS i JOIN `instances` AS t0 ON t0.UUID = i.UUID CROSS JOIN q2_avg_ids AS a) SELECT q2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, COUNT(*) AS forge_instance_count, SUM(q1.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, ROUND(SUM(q1.vcpus) / NULLIF(SUM(q1.memory_mb), 0), 6) AS normalized_vcpu_per_mb_ratio, ROUND(AVG(q2.deviation_from_avg_instance_id), 2) AS avg_deviation_from_avg_instance_id FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.UUID = q1.instance_uuid GROUP BY q2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE ORDER BY normalized_vcpu_per_mb_ratio DESC

WITH CoeffOfVariationByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), CompletedPrimeMigrationsWithWindow AS (SELECT t0.STATUS AS migration_status, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t2.NETWORK_INFO AS instance_network_info, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.DISPLAY_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(t1.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime')) SELECT cpm.migration_status, cpm.instance_display_name, cov.coefficient_of_variation, cpm.instance_network_info, cpm.window_column FROM CompletedPrimeMigrationsWithWindow AS cpm JOIN CoeffOfVariationByDisplayName AS cov ON cov.display_name = cpm.instance_display_name ORDER BY cov.coefficient_of_variation DESC, cpm.instance_display_name

WITH HostCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), FlareCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY m.ID) SELECT hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE, COUNT(DISTINCT hcm.migration_id) AS Completed_Migration_Count, ROUND(AVG(hcm.MEMORY_MB), 0) AS Avg_Instance_Memory_MB, ROUND(AVG(hcm.VCPUS), 2) AS Avg_Instance_VCPUs, ROUND(AVG(hcm.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Min_MemoryTotal_By_Type, ROUND(AVG(fcm.window_column), 2) AS Avg_Running_Avg_MigrationId_For_Flare FROM HostCompletedMigrations AS hcm LEFT JOIN FlareCompletedMigrations AS fcm ON hcm.INSTANCE_UUID = fcm.INSTANCE_UUID AND hcm.migration_id = fcm.migration_id WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(hcm.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') GROUP BY hcm.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY Completed_Migration_Count DESC

WITH CompletedMigrationsOnBlaze AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.MIGRATION_TYPE, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.DEST_HOST, i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.VM_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, m.MEMORY_TOTAL, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) OVER (PARTITION BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE ORDER BY m.MIGRATION_TYPE) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), MemoryStatsByDisplayNameOnBlaze AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT cm.migration_id, cm.INSTANCE_UUID, cm.MIGRATION_TYPE, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_HOST, cm.DISPLAY_NAME, cm.VM_STATE, cm.MEMORY_MB, cm.VCPUS, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.MEMORY_TOTAL, cm.window_column, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev FROM CompletedMigrationsOnBlaze AS cm LEFT JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayNameOnBlaze AS ms ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = cm.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY migration_id, DISPLAY_NAME

WITH RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.root_gb) AS avg_root_gb, STDDEV(i.root_gb) AS root_gb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY root_gb_stddev DESC), Flare3FlareInstances AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor_json, ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY AS numa_topology_json, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info_json, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')) SELECT r.display_name, r.avg_root_gb, r.root_gb_stddev, f.instance_uuid, f.hostname, f.memory_mb, f.vcpus, f.flavor_json, f.numa_topology_json, f.network_info_json, f.window_column FROM RootGbStatsByDisplayName AS r JOIN Flare3FlareInstances AS f ON f.display_name = r.display_name ORDER BY r.root_gb_stddev DESC

WITH PrimeCompletedMigrationStats AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime') GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME), Flare3FlareInstanceWindow AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB) SELECT pcs.DISPLAY_NAME, pcs.min_migration_id, pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb, CASE WHEN COUNT(fw.instance_uuid) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Has_Flare3_Flare_Instances, COUNT(fw.instance_uuid) AS Flare3_Flare_Instance_Count FROM PrimeCompletedMigrationStats AS pcs LEFT JOIN Flare3FlareInstanceWindow AS fw ON pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb = fw.memory_mb WHERE pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb > 0 GROUP BY pcs.DISPLAY_NAME, pcs.min_migration_id, pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb ORDER BY pcs.avg_instance_memory_mb DESC

WITH forge_above_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, c.id AS cache_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb), DisplayNameAverages AS (SELECT i2.display_name, AVG(i2.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM `instances` AS i2 WHERE i2.display_name = 'forge' GROUP BY i2.display_name) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.cache_id, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN DisplayNameAverages ON DisplayNameAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name WHERE inner_cte.memory_mb > (SELECT avg_memory_mb FROM DisplayNameAverages WHERE DisplayNameAverages.display_name = inner_cte.display_name) ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb), display_name_cov AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.memory_mb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.memory_mb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, meta_counts.system_metadata_rows, avg_cov.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(ism.id) AS system_metadata_rows FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name) AS meta_counts ON meta_counts.display_name = inner_cte.display_name, (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) AS avg_cov ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT faa.display_name, faa.uuid, faa.memory_mb, faa.network_info, faa.cache_id, faa.window_column, dnc.coefficient_of_variation, dnc.system_metadata_rows, dnc.avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM forge_above_avg AS faa JOIN display_name_cov AS dnc ON dnc.display_name = faa.display_name ORDER BY faa.memory_mb

WITH image_type_above_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t1.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.VALUE ORDER BY t1.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND t0.DELETED = 0), ValueCounts AS (SELECT metadata_value, COUNT(*) AS value_instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_value), AvgValueCount AS (SELECT AVG(value_instance_count * 1.0) AS avg_value_instance_count FROM ValueCounts) SELECT i.instance_uuid, i.instance_display_name, i.metadata_value, i.network_info FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ValueCounts AS vc ON i.metadata_value = vc.metadata_value WHERE vc.value_instance_count > (SELECT avg_value_instance_count FROM AvgValueCount)), top10_display_names_flare3 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(iic.id) AS cache_records FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY cache_records DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.cache_records, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND i.availability_zone = 'flare3' GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.cache_records ORDER BY inner_cte.cache_records DESC) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ita.instance_uuid) AS matching_instance_count, COUNT(DISTINCT t10.display_name) AS matching_display_name_count FROM image_type_above_avg AS ita JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.uuid = ita.instance_uuid JOIN top10_display_names_flare3 AS t10 ON t10.display_name = i.display_name WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'

WITH confirmed_migrations AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.status, m.source_compute, m.dest_compute, i.display_name, ic.network_info, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY m.status ORDER BY m.status) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'confirmed'), avg_rank AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT c.status, c.source_compute, c.dest_compute, c.display_name, c.network_info, c.window_column, a.avg_window_column, (c.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_dense_rank FROM inner_cte AS c CROSS JOIN avg_rank AS a), forge_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON i2.UUID = ie2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ie2.DELETED <> 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_instance_extra FROM inner_cte AS ic) SELECT cm.status AS migration_status, cm.source_compute, cm.dest_compute, cm.display_name AS migration_instance_display_name, cm.network_info AS migration_network_info, cm.window_column AS migration_dense_rank_within_status, cm.avg_window_column AS avg_migration_dense_rank_across_confirmed, cm.deviation_from_avg_dense_rank, fi.instance_uuid AS forge_instance_uuid, fi.display_name AS forge_display_name, fi.vm_state AS forge_vm_state, fi.memory_mb AS forge_memory_mb, fi.vcpus AS forge_vcpus, fi.instance_extra_id AS forge_instance_extra_id, fi.instance_extra_created_at AS forge_instance_extra_created_at, fi.network_info AS forge_network_info, fi.window_column AS forge_min_instance_extra_id_window, fi.has_deleted_instance_extra FROM confirmed_migrations AS cm JOIN forge_instances AS fi ON fi.display_name = cm.display_name

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12'), avg_meta AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(metadata_value AS FLOAT)) AS avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_value, ic.NETWORK_INFO, ic.window_column, (CAST(ic.metadata_value AS FLOAT) - am.avg_metadata_value) AS deviation_from_avg_metadata_value FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_meta AS am), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(migration_metadata_count) - MIN(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(migration_metadata_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN (SELECT m.instance_uuid, m.id AS migration_id, COUNT(ism.id) AS migration_metadata_count FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i2.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY m.instance_uuid, m.id) AS per_migration_stats ON i.uuid = per_migration_stats.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.metadata_count_range, inner_cte.metadata_count_variance, inner_cte.metadata_count_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i3 ON m2.instance_uuid = i3.uuid WHERE i3.display_name = inner_cte.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.metadata_count_range DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT q1.DISPLAY_NAME, q1.metadata_value, q1.NETWORK_INFO, q1.window_column, q1.deviation_from_avg_metadata_value, q2.metadata_count_range, q2.metadata_count_variance, q2.metadata_count_stddev, q2.has_active_migrations FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.DISPLAY_NAME = q2.display_name

WITH metadata_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, key_counts.total_rows_for_key, avg_counts.avg_rows_per_key FROM AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS per_key) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1), vmstate_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, vcpus, instance_extra_id, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid) SELECT v.vm_state, v.instance_uuid, v.display_name, v.memory_mb, v.vcpus, v.instance_extra_id, v.window_column AS vm_state_row_number, m.flavor, m.metadata_key, m.metadata_value, m.window_column AS metadata_key_row_number, m.total_rows_for_key, m.avg_rows_per_key FROM vmstate_cte AS v JOIN metadata_cte AS m ON m.instance_uuid = v.instance_uuid ORDER BY v.vm_state, v.instance_uuid, m.metadata_key, m.window_column

WITH blaze_host_minmax AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT i.HOST AS instance_host, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.HOST), ether_dest_compute_details AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS migration_memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.DEST_COMPUTE ORDER BY m.DEST_COMPUTE) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'ether-18') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DEST_COMPUTE) OVER (ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) = DEST_COMPUTE THEN NULL ELSE DEST_COMPUTE END AS dest_compute, migration_id, migration_status, SOURCE_COMPUTE, DEST_HOST, INSTANCE_UUID, instance_display_name, instance_vm_state, instance_memory_mb, instance_vcpus, metadata_key, metadata_value, migration_memory_remaining, window_column AS min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY DEST_COMPUTE) AS total_rows_in_dest_compute FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DEST_COMPUTE, migration_id, metadata_key) SELECT ed.dest_compute, ed.total_rows_in_dest_compute, ed.min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute, bh.instance_host AS blaze_instance_host, bh.max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining, ROUND(ed.min_migration_memory_remaining_in_dest_compute / NULLIF(bh.max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining, 0), 4) AS min_dest_compute_memory_remaining_to_blaze_max_instance_min_ratio FROM ether_dest_compute_details AS ed CROSS JOIN blaze_host_minmax AS bh ORDER BY ed.dest_compute, ed.migration_id, ed.metadata_key

WITH metadata_rows AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS per_key) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1), vmstate_rows AS (WITH inner_cte AS i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid) = vm_state THEN NULL ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, instance_uuid, display_name, memory_mb, vcpus, instance_extra_id, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY vm_state, instance_uuid) SELECT v.vm_state, v.instance_uuid, v.display_name, v.memory_mb, v.vcpus, v.instance_extra_id, v.window_column AS vm_state_row_number, m.flavor, m.metadata_key, m.metadata_value, m.window_column AS metadata_key_row_number, m.total_rows_for_key, m.avg_rows_per_key FROM vmstate_rows AS v JOIN metadata_rows AS m ON m.instance_uuid = v.instance_uuid ORDER BY v.vm_state, v.instance_uuid, m.metadata_key, m.window_column

WITH MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, inner_cte.memory_mb_stddev HAVING (AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) * 1.0 / MAX(i.MEMORY_MB)) > 0.75 ORDER BY avg_memory_mb DESC), CompletedMigrationMetadataRownum AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ism.`KEY` ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), avg_window AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, aw.avg_window_column AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.window_column > aw.avg_window_column THEN 'ABOVE_AVG_ROWNUM' WHEN ic.window_column < aw.avg_window_column THEN 'BELOW_AVG_ROWNUM' ELSE 'AT_AVG_ROWNUM' END AS rownum_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_window AS aw) SELECT cmr.migration_id, cmr.instance_display_name, ms.memory_mb_variance, ms.memory_mb_stddev, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.max_memory_mb, cmr.metadata_key, cmr.metadata_value, cmr.window_column, cmr.benchmark, cmr.rownum_category FROM CompletedMigrationMetadataRownum AS cmr JOIN MemoryStatsByDisplayName AS ms ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = cmr.instance_display_name ORDER BY ms.avg_memory_mb DESC, cmr.migration_id, cmr.metadata_key

WITH mem_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb, AVG(memory_mb_stddev) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM inner_cte GROUP BY display_name WITH ROLLUP), host_metadata_network AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, iic.ID AS instance_info_cache_id FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID) SELECT ms.display_name, ms.avg_memory_mb, ms.memory_mb_stddev, hmn.metadata_value, hmn.network_info, hmn.window_column, hmn.instance_uuid, hmn.instance_info_cache_id FROM mem_stats AS ms JOIN host_metadata_network AS hmn ON hmn.display_name = ms.display_name WHERE REGEXP_LIKE(ms.display_name, 'prime')

ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.memory_total_stddev, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.display_name = ic.display_name AND m2.deleted = 0 AND NOT m2.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_migrations FROM inner_cte AS ic ORDER BY ic.memory_total_stddev DESC LIMIT 10), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS ism JOIN `instances` AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.network_info, ic.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS ism2 WHERE ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ism2.`KEY` <> 'image_image_type' AND ism2.DELETED = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_other_system_metadata FROM inner_cte AS ic ORDER BY ic.instance_uuid, ic.metadata_value) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.memory_total_stddev, q1.has_active_migrations, q2.instance_uuid, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.network_info, q2.avg_memory_mb_window_2_pre_2_fol, q2.has_other_system_metadata FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.instance_display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.memory_total_stddev DESC, q2.instance_uuid, q2.metadata_value

FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, total_forge_instances, AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS forge_stats ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY LAG(project_name) OVER (ORDER BY project_sort, project_name) = project_name THEN NULL ELSE project_name END AS project_id, instance_id, instance_uuid, user_id, hostname, vm_state, power_state, memory_mb, vcpus, availability_zone, info_cache_id, network_info, window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_project, total_instances, avg_memory_mb FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(project_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE project_id END AS project_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(project_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE project_id END AS project_name, instance_id, instance_uuid, user_id, hostname, vm_state, power_state, q2.vcpus, q2.availability_zone, q2.info_cache_id, q2.network_info, q2.min_memory_mb_in_project, q2.total_instances AS total_forge_instances_in_project, q2.avg_memory_mb AS avg_forge_memory_mb_in_project, q1.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_within_display_name_ordered_by_memory, q1.total_forge_instances AS total_forge_instances_overall, q1.avg_forge_memory_mb AS avg_forge_memory_mb_overall FROM q2 LEFT JOIN q1 ON q2.instance_uuid = q1.uuid ORDER BY q2.project_id, q2.instance_id

WITH prime_variability AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(c.updated_at - i.created_at) / NULLIF(AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS e ON e.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(c.updated_at - i.created_at) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.coefficient_of_variation, ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation > ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIABILITY' WHEN ic.coefficient_of_variation < ac.avg_coefficient_of_variation * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIABILITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIABILITY' END AS variability_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac ORDER BY ic.coefficient_of_variation DESC), flare_memory AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare') ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.hostname, ic.memory_mb, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.window_column, oa.overall_avg_memory_mb, (ic.memory_mb - oa.overall_avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa ORDER BY ic.memory_mb), CombinedResults AS (SELECT pv.display_name AS entity_name, pv.coefficient_of_variation AS metric_value, pv.benchmark AS benchmark_value, pv.variability_category AS category, 'Prime display-name cache-update variability' AS reason FROM prime_variability AS pv UNION ALL SELECT fm.instance_uuid AS entity_name, fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb AS metric_value, fm.overall_avg_memory_mb AS benchmark_value, CASE WHEN fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb > 0 THEN 'ABOVE_OVERALL_AVG' WHEN fm.deviation_from_overall_avg_memory_mb < 0 THEN 'BELOW_OVERALL_AVG' ELSE 'AT_OVERALL_AVG' END AS category, 'Flare3 instance memory deviation' AS reason FROM flare_memory AS fm) SELECT entity_name, metric_value, benchmark_value, category, reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY entity_name

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), Enriched AS (SELECT ic.display_name, ism2.value AS image_type, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m WHERE (m.source_compute = i.host OR m.dest_compute = i.host) AND m.deleted = 0 AND NOT m.status IN ('completed', 'failed', 'error')) THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS host_migration_status, ic.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.display_name = ic.display_name AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism2 ON ism2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism2.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND ism2.deleted = 0 JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic2 ON iic2.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND iic2.deleted = 0) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(image_type) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE image_type END AS image_type, CASE WHEN GROUPING(host_migration_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(image_type) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE host_migration_status END AS host_migration_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(host_migration_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM Enriched GROUP BY image_type, host_migration_status, display_name WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.status FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, MAX(inner_cte.max_memory_total) AS max_completed_migration_memory_total FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name) SELECT q1.image_type, q1.host_migration_status, q1.display_name, q1.avg_coefficient_of_variation, q1.row_count, q2.max_completed_migration_memory_total FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.display_name = q1.display_name ORDER BY q1.image_type, q1.host_migration_status, q1.display_name

WITH Q1_inner_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, m.status, MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total, m.created_at FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0), AvgOfGroupMax AS (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.max_memory_total * 1.0) AS avg_group_max_memory_total FROM inner_cte) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.status, inner_cte.max_memory_total, inner_cte.created_at FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.max_memory_total > (SELECT avg_group_max_memory_total FROM AvgOfGroupMax)), Q2_inner_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MIN(m.ID) AS min_migration_id, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_instance_memory_mb FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime') GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.min_migration_id, inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.avg_instance_memory_mb > (SELECT AVG(inner_cte2.avg_instance_memory_mb) FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2)) SELECT q1.display_name, q1.status, q1.max_memory_total, q1.created_at, q2.min_migration_id, q2.avg_instance_memory_mb FROM Q1_inner_cte AS q1 JOIN Q2_inner_cte AS q2 ON q1.display_name = q2.DISPLAY_NAME

WITH StateRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), StateCounts AS (SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS total_instances FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(vm_state) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE vm_state END AS vm_state, CASE WHEN GROUPING(power_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(vm_state) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(power_state AS CHAR) END AS power_state, SUM(total_instances) AS total_instances FROM StateCounts GROUP BY vm_state, power_state WITH ROLLUP), MigrationCV AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, STDDEV(m.memory_remaining) / NULLIF(AVG(m.memory_remaining), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING AVG(m.memory_remaining) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(m2.id) AS completed_migration_count FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON i2.vm_state = inner_cte.vm_state JOIN `migrations` AS m2 ON m2.instance_uuid = i2.uuid WHERE m2.status = 'completed' AND i2.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT sr.vm_state, sr.power_state, sr.total_instances, mc.coefficient_of_variation, mc.completed_migration_count FROM StateRollup AS sr LEFT JOIN MigrationCV AS mc ON mc.vm_state = sr.vm_state ORDER BY CASE WHEN sr.vm_state = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 WHEN sr.power_state = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, sr.vm_state, sr.power_state

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.VALUE ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS ism JOIN `instances` AS i ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY i.CREATED_AT) SELECT instance_uuid, instance_display_name, metadata_key, metadata_value, network_info, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY window_column DESC, instance_uuid), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, COUNT(ism.ID) AS metadata_records FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'prime') GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY metadata_records DESC LIMIT 10), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(metadata_records) AS avg_metadata_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.DISPLAY_NAME, ic.metadata_records, (ic.metadata_records - ac.avg_metadata_records) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS ac ORDER BY ic.metadata_records DESC) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.instance_display_name, q1.metadata_key, q1.metadata_value, q1.network_info, q1.window_column, q2.metadata_records, q2.deviation_from_avg FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.instance_display_name = q2.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY q1.window_column DESC, q2.metadata_records DESC, q1.instance_uuid

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.INSTANCE_UUID, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' ORDER BY m.ID), instance_rollup AS (SELECT INSTANCE_UUID, COUNT(*) AS total_metadata_rows, AVG(window_column) AS avg_running_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY INSTANCE_UUID) SELECT ic.migration_id, ic.INSTANCE_UUID, ic.SOURCE_COMPUTE, ic.DEST_COMPUTE, ic.instance_display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.window_column, ir.total_metadata_rows, ir.avg_running_avg_migration_id FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN instance_rollup AS ir ON ic.INSTANCE_UUID = ir.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY ic.migration_id), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.UUID ORDER BY ism.`KEY`) AS window_column FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS ism2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE ism2.INSTANCE_UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid AND ism2.DELETED <> 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_system_metadata FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.metadata_key) SELECT q2.hostname, q2.instance_uuid, q2.instance_extra_id, q2.metadata_key, q2.metadata_value, q2.window_column AS running_avg_instance_memory_mb, q2.has_deleted_system_metadata, q1.migration_id, q1.SOURCE_COMPUTE, q1.DEST_COMPUTE, q1.instance_display_name, q1.window_column AS running_avg_migration_id, q1.total_metadata_rows, q1.avg_running_avg_migration_id, ROUND(q1.avg_running_avg_migration_id / NULLIF(q2.window_column, 0), 6) AS normalized_avg_migration_id_per_running_avg_memory FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q1.INSTANCE_UUID = q2.instance_uuid AND q1.metadata_key = q2.metadata_key AND q1.metadata_value = q2.metadata_value ORDER BY normalized_avg_migration_id_per_running_avg_memory DESC, q2.instance_uuid, q2.metadata_key, q1.migration_id

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.flavor, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.window_column, key_counts.total_rows_for_key, avg_counts.avg_rows_per_key FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS total_rows_for_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS key_counts ON key_counts.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key JOIN (SELECT AVG(rows_per_key) AS avg_rows_per_key FROM (SELECT metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS rows_per_key FROM inner_cte GROUP BY metadata_key) AS per_key) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ie.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME, ie.FLAVOR, ism.`KEY`, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY ism.`KEY`) AS window_column FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0 AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID, inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.FLAVOR, inner_cte.`KEY`, inner_cte.window_column, i.MEMORY_MB FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON inner_cte.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.MEMORY_MB > 16384) SELECT q1.instance_uuid, q1.display_name, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.flavor, q1.metadata_key, q1.metadata_value, q1.window_column AS row_number_within_key_by_uuid, q1.total_rows_for_key, q1.avg_rows_per_key, q2.window_column AS dense_rank_within_key, q2.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb_gt_16gb FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.INSTANCE_UUID = q1.instance_uuid AND q2.`KEY` = q1.metadata_key ORDER BY q1.metadata_key, q1.instance_uuid

WITH vm_state_memory_thresholds AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.vm_state, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.vm_state HAVING SUM(i.memory_mb) > (SELECT AVG(i2.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i2.memory_mb) FROM `instances` AS i2 JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie2 ON i2.uuid = ie2.instance_uuid WHERE i2.deleted = 0)) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.total_memory_mb, threshold_stats.avg_plus_stddev AS avg_plus_stddev_threshold FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(i3.memory_mb) + STDDEV(i3.memory_mb) AS avg_plus_stddev FROM `instances` AS i3 JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie3 ON i3.uuid = ie3.instance_uuid WHERE i3.deleted = 0) AS threshold_stats), instance_project_window_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, project_totals.total_instances_in_project, avg_instances.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS project_totals ON inner_cte.project_id = project_totals.project_id, (SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS sub) AS avg_instances ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_id) SELECT ips.instance_id, ips.instance_uuid, ips.user_id, ips.project_id, ips.display_name, ips.vm_state, ips.memory_mb, ips.vcpus, ips.info_cache_id, ips.max_instance_id_next_2, ips.total_instances_in_project, ips.avg_instance_count, vst.total_memory_mb AS vm_state_total_memory_mb, vst.avg_plus_stddev_threshold FROM instance_project_window_stats AS ips JOIN vm_state_memory_thresholds AS vst ON ips.vm_state = vst.vm_state ORDER BY ips.instance_id

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) AS total_ports_covered FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME HAVING SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) > 100) SELECT security_group_name, total_ports_covered FROM inner_cte WHERE total_ports_covered > (SELECT AVG(total_ports_covered) FROM inner_cte)

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, AVG(i.MEMORY_MB) AS avg_memory_mb, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) - MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_range, VARIANCE(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_variance FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ie.PCI_REQUESTS <> '[]' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_mb_range DESC) SELECT inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.avg_memory_mb, inner_cte.memory_mb_range, inner_cte.memory_mb_variance, overall_avg.avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(avg_memory_mb) AS avg_of_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS overall_avg

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.PROTOCOL AS rule_protocol, sgr.CIDR AS rule_cidr, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sgr.CIDR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon'), RuleStatusCounts AS (SELECT ic.rule_protocol, CASE WHEN sgr2.DELETED = 0 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS rule_status, COUNT(*) AS total_rules FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr2 ON sgr2.CIDR = ic.rule_cidr AND sgr2.PROTOCOL = ic.rule_protocol GROUP BY ic.rule_protocol, rule_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(rule_protocol) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE rule_protocol END AS rule_protocol, CASE WHEN GROUPING(rule_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(rule_protocol) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE rule_status END AS rule_status, SUM(total_rules) AS total_rules FROM RuleStatusCounts GROUP BY rule_protocol, rule_status WITH ROLLUP

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS resource, AVG(r.DELTA) AS avg_reservation_delta, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS reservation_delta_stddev FROM `quota_usages` AS qu JOIN `reservations` AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY reservation_delta_stddev DESC) SELECT inner_cte.resource, inner_cte.avg_reservation_delta, inner_cte.reservation_delta_stddev, AVG(qu.IN_USE) AS avg_in_use FROM inner_cte JOIN `quota_usages` AS qu ON qu.RESOURCE = inner_cte.resource AND qu.DELETED = 0 WHERE inner_cte.avg_reservation_delta > 0.10 * qu.IN_USE GROUP BY inner_cte.resource, inner_cte.avg_reservation_delta, inner_cte.reservation_delta_stddev ORDER BY inner_cte.avg_reservation_delta DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME, sg.DESCRIPTION, sg.PROJECT_ID, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, sgr.TO_PORT, sgr.CIDR, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sg.ID ORDER BY sgr.ID) AS window_column FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 AND sgr.DELETED = 0), RuleCounts AS (SELECT NAME, DESCRIPTION, PROJECT_ID, PROTOCOL, COUNT(*) AS total_rules FROM inner_cte GROUP BY NAME, DESCRIPTION, PROJECT_ID, PROTOCOL) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(NAME) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE NAME END AS security_group_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(DESCRIPTION) = 1 AND GROUPING(NAME) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE DESCRIPTION END AS security_group_description, CASE WHEN GROUPING(PROJECT_ID) = 1 AND GROUPING(NAME) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE PROJECT_ID END AS project_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(PROTOCOL) = 1 AND GROUPING(NAME) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE PROTOCOL END AS protocol, SUM(total_rules) AS total_rules FROM RuleCounts GROUP BY NAME, DESCRIPTION, PROJECT_ID, PROTOCOL WITH ROLLUP

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_variance DESC), tcp_rule_counts AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, COUNT(*) AS tcp_rule_count FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME), avg_tcp_rule_count AS (SELECT AVG(tcp_rule_count * 1.0) AS avg_tcp_rule_count FROM tcp_rule_counts) SELECT i.security_group_name, i.from_port_variance, trc.tcp_rule_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN tcp_rule_counts AS trc ON i.security_group_name = trc.security_group_name CROSS JOIN avg_tcp_rule_count AS a WHERE trc.tcp_rule_count > a.avg_tcp_rule_count ORDER BY i.from_port_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.hostname, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.availability_zone, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_project, COUNT(inner_cte.instance_id) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.project_id) AS total_forge_instances_in_project, avg_counts.avg_forge_instances_per_project FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(forge_instance_count) AS avg_forge_instances_per_project FROM (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS forge_instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS per_project_counts) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT q.ID AS quota_usage_id, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE, q.IN_USE, q.RESERVED, r.UUID AS reservation_uuid, MAX(r.DELTA) OVER (ORDER BY r.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_delta_next_2 FROM `quota_usages` AS q JOIN `reservations` AS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.DELETED = 0), ResourceInUseAverages AS (SELECT q2.RESOURCE, AVG(q2.IN_USE * 1.0) AS avg_in_use FROM `quota_usages` AS q2 WHERE q2.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY q2.RESOURCE) SELECT i.quota_usage_id, i.PROJECT_ID, i.RESOURCE, i.IN_USE, i.RESERVED, i.reservation_uuid, i.max_delta_next_2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ResourceInUseAverages AS a ON a.RESOURCE = i.RESOURCE WHERE i.IN_USE > (SELECT a2.avg_in_use FROM ResourceInUseAverages AS a2 WHERE a2.RESOURCE = i.RESOURCE)

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.ID AS security_group_id, sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sg.DESCRIPTION AS security_group_description, COUNT(sgr.ID) AS rule_count, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT) AS total_to_port FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.ID, sg.NAME, sg.DESCRIPTION), CidrBreakdown AS (SELECT sg.ID AS security_group_id, sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sg.DESCRIPTION AS security_group_description, sgr.CIDR AS cidr, COUNT(sgr.ID) AS cidr_rule_count, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT) AS cidr_total_to_port FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID JOIN inner_cte AS i ON i.security_group_id = sg.ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.ID, sg.NAME, sg.DESCRIPTION, sgr.CIDR) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(security_group_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE security_group_id END AS security_group_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(security_group_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE security_group_name END AS security_group_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(security_group_description) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE security_group_description END AS security_group_description, CASE WHEN GROUPING(cidr) = 1 AND GROUPING(security_group_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(cidr) = 1 AND GROUPING(security_group_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE cidr END AS cidr, SUM(cidr_rule_count) AS rule_count, SUM(cidr_total_to_port) AS total_to_port FROM CidrBreakdown GROUP BY security_group_id, security_group_name, security_group_description, cidr WITH ROLLUP

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY i.UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3') SELECT inner_cte.metadata_key AS metadata_key, COUNT(*) AS metadata_row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.instance_uuid) AS distinct_instance_count, SUM(inner_cte.vcpus) AS total_vcpus, SUM(inner_cte.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie2 WHERE ie2.INSTANCE_UUID IN (SELECT DISTINCT inner_cte2.instance_uuid FROM inner_cte AS inner_cte2 WHERE inner_cte2.metadata_key = inner_cte.metadata_key) AND NOT ie2.MIGRATION_CONTEXT IS NULL) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_migration_context FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.metadata_key ORDER BY metadata_row_count DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT q.ID AS usage_id, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE, COUNT(r.ID) AS reservation_count, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta FROM `quota_usages` AS q JOIN `reservations` AS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.IN_USE > 0 GROUP BY q.ID, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE), ProjectResourceStatus AS (SELECT i.PROJECT_ID, i.RESOURCE, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `quota_usages` AS q2 JOIN inner_cte AS i2 ON i2.usage_id = q2.ID WHERE q2.IN_USE > 0 AND q2.PROJECT_ID = i.PROJECT_ID AND q2.RESOURCE = i.RESOURCE AND i2.total_reserved_delta > q2.IN_USE) THEN 'High' ELSE 'Normal' END AS reservation_pressure, COUNT(DISTINCT i.usage_id) AS usage_records, SUM(i.reservation_count) AS total_reservations, SUM(i.total_reserved_delta) AS total_reserved_delta FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.PROJECT_ID, i.RESOURCE, reservation_pressure) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(PROJECT_ID) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE PROJECT_ID END AS project_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(RESOURCE) = 1 AND GROUPING(PROJECT_ID) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE RESOURCE END AS resource, CASE WHEN GROUPING(reservation_pressure) = 1 AND GROUPING(RESOURCE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(reservation_pressure) = 1 AND GROUPING(RESOURCE) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE reservation_pressure END AS reservation_pressure, SUM(usage_records) AS usage_records, SUM(total_reservations) AS total_reservations, SUM(total_reserved_delta) AS total_reserved_delta FROM ProjectResourceStatus GROUP BY PROJECT_ID, RESOURCE, reservation_pressure WITH ROLLUP

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, MAX(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.UUID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND ism.DELETED = 0) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.metadata_key, inner_cte.metadata_value, inner_cte.max_instance_extra_id_next_2 FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.memory_mb * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.vcpus, 0)) > 2048

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT q.RESOURCE AS resource, EXP(AVG(LN(r.DELTA))) AS geometric_mean FROM `quota_usages` AS q JOIN `reservations` AS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE r.DELTA > 0 GROUP BY q.RESOURCE ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC) SELECT resource, geometric_mean FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean > (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC

WITH top_projects AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `instance_extra` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.DELETED = 0) SELECT i.project_id AS project_id, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON ic.uuid = i2.uuid WHERE i2.project_id = i.project_id AND ic.window_column = 1) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_rank1_instance_by_window FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.project_id ORDER BY total_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10), instance_details AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.id AS instance_id, i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.user_id, i.project_id, i.display_name, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, c.id AS info_cache_id, MAX(i.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.id ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND c.deleted = 0) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.user_id, inner_cte.project_id, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, project_totals.total_instances_in_project, avg_instances.avg_instance_count FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS total_instances_in_project FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS project_totals ON inner_cte.project_id = project_totals.project_id, (SELECT AVG(instance_count) AS avg_instance_count FROM (SELECT project_id, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY project_id) AS sub) AS avg_instances ORDER BY inner_cte.instance_id) SELECT tp.project_id, tp.total_memory_mb, tp.has_rank1_instance_by_window, id.instance_id, id.instance_uuid, id.user_id, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.info_cache_id, id.max_instance_id_next_2, id.total_instances_in_project, id.avg_instance_count FROM top_projects AS tp JOIN instance_details AS id ON id.project_id = tp.project_id ORDER BY tp.total_memory_mb DESC, id.instance_id

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(q.ID) AS min_usage_id, AVG(r.DELTA) AS avg_reservation_delta FROM `quota_usages` AS q JOIN `reservations` AS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.DELETED = 0 AND r.RESOURCE IN ('cores', 'instances') GROUP BY q.RESOURCE), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(r.DELTA) AS overall_avg_reservation_delta FROM `quota_usages` AS q JOIN `reservations` AS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.DELETED = 0 AND r.RESOURCE IN ('cores', 'instances')) SELECT i.min_usage_id, i.avg_reservation_delta, (i.avg_reservation_delta - oa.overall_avg_reservation_delta) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND iic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), DisplayNameImageTypeStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, ism.value AS image_type, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(*) AS instance_count FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.display_name = i.display_name WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND ism.deleted = 0 AND iic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name, ism.value HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(display_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE display_name END AS display_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(image_type) = 1 AND GROUPING(display_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE image_type END AS image_type, AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation, SUM(instance_count) AS total_instances FROM DisplayNameImageTypeStats GROUP BY display_name, image_type WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY GROUPING(display_name), display_name, GROUPING(image_type), image_type

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS quota_resource, AVG(r.DELTA) AS avg_delta, VARIANCE(r.DELTA) AS delta_variance, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS delta_stddev FROM `quota_usages` AS qu JOIN `reservations` AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY delta_variance DESC), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_delta) AS overall_avg_delta FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.quota_resource, ic.avg_delta, ic.delta_variance, ic.delta_stddev, oa.overall_avg_delta AS benchmark_avg_delta, CASE WHEN ic.avg_delta > oa.overall_avg_delta * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DELTA' WHEN ic.avg_delta < oa.overall_avg_delta * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DELTA' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DELTA' END AS delta_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT qu.ID AS usage_id, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta FROM `quota_usages` AS qu JOIN `reservations` AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE r.expire < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY qu.ID HAVING SUM(r.DELTA) > (SELECT AVG(DELTA) + STDDEV(DELTA) FROM `reservations` WHERE expire < '2021-11-16 19:30:59')) SELECT inner_cte.usage_id, qu.RESOURCE AS usage_resource, inner_cte.total_reserved_delta FROM inner_cte JOIN `quota_usages` AS qu ON qu.ID = inner_cte.usage_id WHERE qu.DELETED = 0

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t0.IN_USE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `quota_usages` AS t0 JOIN `reservations` AS t1 ON t0.ID = t1.USAGE_ID WHERE t1.RESOURCE = 'cores' AND t1.EXPIRE < '2021-05-13 16:53:07') SELECT r.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta, MAX(i.window_column) AS max_dense_rank_in_project, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `reservations` AS r2 JOIN `quota_usages` AS q2 ON q2.ID = r2.USAGE_ID WHERE r2.PROJECT_ID = r.PROJECT_ID AND r2.RESOURCE = 'cores' AND r2.EXPIRE < '2021-05-13 16:53:07' AND q2.RESERVED > 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_positive_reserved_quota FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `reservations` AS r ON r.UUID = i.UUID JOIN `quota_usages` AS q ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE r.RESOURCE = 'cores' AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-05-13 16:53:07' GROUP BY r.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY total_reserved_delta DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12') SELECT i.HOST AS instance_host, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_of_instance_min_memory_remaining FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.UUID = inner_cte.instance_uuid GROUP BY i.HOST

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.ID AS security_group_id, sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.ID AS rule_id, sgr.CIDR AS rule_cidr, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sg.ID ORDER BY sgr.ID) AS window_column FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID JOIN `services` AS s ON s.`binary` = 'nova-scheduler' WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp') SELECT security_group_id, security_group_name, rule_id, rule_cidr, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE rule_id > (SELECT AVG(rule_id) FROM inner_cte)

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.name, STDDEV(sgr.to_port - sgr.from_port) / NULLIF(AVG(sgr.to_port - sgr.from_port), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.id = sgr.parent_group_id JOIN `instance_types` AS it ON 1 = 1 WHERE sg.deleted = 0 AND sgr.deleted = 0 AND it.disabled = FALSE GROUP BY sg.name HAVING AVG(sgr.to_port - sgr.from_port) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), OverallAvg AS (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_cov FROM inner_cte) SELECT inner_cte.name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT avg_cov FROM OverallAvg) ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.UUID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t0.IN_USE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `quota_usages` AS t0 JOIN `reservations` AS t1 ON t0.ID = t1.USAGE_ID WHERE t1.RESOURCE = 'cores' AND t1.EXPIRE < '2021-05-13 16:53:07') SELECT r.PROJECT_ID, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS max_dense_rank FROM inner_cte JOIN `reservations` AS r ON r.UUID = inner_cte.UUID GROUP BY r.PROJECT_ID

WITH top_groups_2014 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) AS max_memory_mb, i.LAUNCHED_AT FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.LAUNCHED_AT) = 2014 GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME, i.LAUNCHED_AT HAVING MAX(i.MEMORY_MB) > 16000) SELECT inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME, inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT, inner_cte.max_memory_mb, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instances` AS i2 JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie2 ON ie2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = inner_cte.DISPLAY_NAME AND i2.LAUNCHED_AT = inner_cte.LAUNCHED_AT AND NOT ie2.NUMA_TOPOLOGY IS NULL AND ie2.NUMA_TOPOLOGY <> '') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_numa_topology FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.max_memory_mb DESC LIMIT 10), forge_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, ie.CREATED_AT AS instance_extra_created_at, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info, MIN(ie.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT ic.instance_uuid, ic.display_name, ic.vm_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.instance_extra_id, ic.instance_extra_created_at, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `instance_extra` AS ie2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON i2.UUID = ie2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i2.UUID = ic.instance_uuid AND ie2.DELETED <> 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_deleted_instance_extra FROM inner_cte AS ic) SELECT tg.DISPLAY_NAME AS group_display_name, tg.LAUNCHED_AT AS group_launched_at, tg.max_memory_mb AS group_max_memory_mb, tg.has_numa_topology AS group_has_numa_topology, COUNT(fi.instance_uuid) AS forge_instance_count_in_group, MAX(CASE WHEN fi.has_deleted_instance_extra = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS any_forge_instance_has_deleted_instance_extra FROM top_groups_2014 AS tg LEFT JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.DISPLAY_NAME = tg.DISPLAY_NAME AND i.LAUNCHED_AT = tg.LAUNCHED_AT LEFT JOIN forge_instances AS fi ON fi.instance_uuid = i.UUID GROUP BY tg.DISPLAY_NAME, tg.LAUNCHED_AT, tg.max_memory_mb, tg.has_numa_topology ORDER BY tg.max_memory_mb DESC

WITH forge_instances AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.uuid, i.memory_mb, c.network_info, c.id AS cache_id, AVG(i.memory_mb) OVER (PARTITION BY i.display_name ORDER BY i.memory_mb) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid WHERE i.display_name = 'forge' ORDER BY i.memory_mb) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.uuid, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.network_info, inner_cte.cache_id, inner_cte.window_column, forge_stats.total_forge_instances, forge_stats.avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_forge_instances, AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_forge_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) AS forge_stats ON 1 = 1 ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_mb), shelved_offloaded_with_cache AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS shelved_offloaded_instances_with_cache FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND ic.DELETED = 0) SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ic.UPDATED_AT AS cache_updated_at FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND i.DELETED = 0 AND ic.DELETED = 0) SELECT fi.display_name, fi.uuid AS forge_instance_uuid, fi.memory_mb AS forge_memory_mb, fi.network_info AS forge_cached_network_info, fi.cache_id AS forge_cache_id, fi.window_column AS avg_memory_mb_within_display_name_ordered_by_memory, fi.total_forge_instances, fi.avg_forge_memory_mb, so.hostname AS shelved_offloaded_hostname, so.memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_memory_mb, so.vcpus AS shelved_offloaded_vcpus, so.cache_updated_at AS shelved_offloaded_cache_updated_at, ROUND(fi.memory_mb / NULLIF(so.memory_mb, 0), 2) AS forge_to_shelved_offloaded_memory_ratio FROM forge_instances AS fi JOIN shelved_offloaded_with_cache AS so ON so.instance_uuid = fi.uuid ORDER BY fi.memory_mb

SELECT COUNT(*) AS qemu_compute_nodes_with_resource_provider FROM `compute_nodes` AS cn JOIN `resource_providers` AS rp ON cn.UUID = rp.UUID JOIN `aggregate_hosts` AS ah ON ah.HOST = cn.HOST WHERE cn.HYPERVISOR_TYPE = 'QEMU' AND ah.AGGREGATE_ID = '1'
