SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3'), TopCompletedMigrations AS (SELECT i.display_name, COUNT(m.id) AS completed_migrations FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE m.status = 'completed' AND NOT i.key_name IS NULL GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT id.instance_uuid, id.display_name, id.vm_state, id.power_state, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.instance_extra_id, id.max_instance_id_next_2, tcm.completed_migrations, ROUND(tcm.completed_migrations / NULLIF(id.vcpus, 0), 2) AS completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM InstanceDetails AS id JOIN TopCompletedMigrations AS tcm ON tcm.display_name = id.display_name ORDER BY completed_migrations_per_vcpu DESC, tcm.completed_migrations DESC), OverallAvg AS (SELECT AVG(inner_cte.completed_migrations * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.vcpus, 0)) AS avg_completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM inner_cte) SELECT inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.vm_state, inner_cte.power_state, inner_cte.memory_mb, inner_cte.vcpus, inner_cte.instance_extra_id, inner_cte.max_instance_id_next_2, inner_cte.completed_migrations, inner_cte.completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM inner_cte WHERE (inner_cte.completed_migrations * 1.0 / NULLIF(inner_cte.vcpus, 0)) > (SELECT avg_completed_migrations_per_vcpu FROM OverallAvg) ORDER BY inner_cte.completed_migrations_per_vcpu DESC, inner_cte.completed_migrations DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH instance_zone_metadata_rank AS (SELECT t1.UUID AS instance_uuid, t2.VALUE AS metadata_value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.MEMORY_MB ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `instance_extra` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t1.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND t2.`KEY` = 'image_image_type'), completed_migrations_memory AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type AS (SELECT cmm.instance_uuid, cmm.instance_display_name, cmm.instance_hostname, cmm.migration_source_compute, cmm.migration_dest_compute, cmm.migration_dest_host, cmm.migration_type, cmm.memory_total, cmm.memory_processed, cmm.memory_remaining, cmm.window_column AS min_memory_remaining_within_instance_uuid FROM completed_migrations_memory AS cmm JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.UUID = cmm.instance_uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type') SELECT COUNT(*) AS flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type_count FROM flare3_completed_migrations_with_image_type), flare3_migrations_detail AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND m.STATUS = 'completed' AND ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type'), flare3_avg_memory_remaining AS (SELECT AVG(fmd.memory_remaining * 1.0) AS avg_memory_remaining FROM flare3_migrations_detail AS fmd) SELECT fmd.instance_uuid, fmd.instance_display_name, fmd.instance_hostname, fmd.migration_type, fmd.memory_remaining FROM flare3_migrations_detail AS fmd WHERE fmd.memory_remaining > (SELECT avg_memory_remaining FROM flare3_avg_memory_remaining)

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), ZoneAverages AS (SELECT i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, AVG(i2.MEMORY_MB * 1.0) AS avg_zone_memory_mb FROM `instances` AS i2 WHERE i2.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge' GROUP BY i2.AVAILABILITY_ZONE) SELECT inner_cte.instance_id, inner_cte.instance_uuid, inner_cte.USER_ID, inner_cte.PROJECT_ID, inner_cte.HOSTNAME, inner_cte.VM_STATE, inner_cte.POWER_STATE, inner_cte.MEMORY_MB, inner_cte.VCPUS, inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, inner_cte.info_cache_id, inner_cte.NETWORK_INFO, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ZoneAverages AS za ON za.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = inner_cte.AVAILABILITY_ZONE WHERE inner_cte.MEMORY_MB > za.avg_zone_memory_mb), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) AS min_instance_memory_mb, SUM(m.MEMORY_PROCESSED) AS total_migration_memory_processed FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.UUID = ic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded') SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `migrations` AS m2 JOIN `instances` AS i2 ON m2.INSTANCE_UUID = i2.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic2 ON i2.UUID = ic2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m2.STATUS = 'completed' AND i2.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' AND ic2.DELETED = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_network_info_cache FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.VM_STATE = 'shelved_offloaded' GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, inner_cte.min_instance_memory_mb, inner_cte.total_migration_memory_processed) SELECT q1.instance_id, q1.instance_uuid, q1.user_id, q1.project_id, q1.hostname, q1.vm_state, q1.power_state, q1.memory_mb, q1.vcpus, q1.availability_zone, q1.info_cache_id, q1.network_info, q1.window_column AS min_memory_mb_within_project, q2.min_instance_memory_mb AS shelved_offloaded_min_instance_memory_mb, q2.total_migration_memory_processed, q2.has_network_info_cache FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.vm_state = q1.vm_state WHERE q1.vm_state = 'shelved_offloaded' ORDER BY q1.availability_zone, q1.project_id, q1.instance_id

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MetadataCountStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.display_name, MAX(meta_entry_count) - MIN(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_range, VARIANCE(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_variance, STDDEV(meta_entry_count) AS metadata_count_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN (SELECT i2.display_name, i2.uuid, COUNT(*) AS meta_entry_count FROM `instances` AS i2 JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i2.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i2.display_name, i2.uuid) AS per_instance_counts ON i.display_name = per_instance_counts.display_name GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY metadata_count_range DESC), InstanceMetadataDetails AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.USER_ID AS user_id, i.PROJECT_ID AS project_id, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE AS availability_zone, ism.`KEY` AS metadata_key, ism.VALUE AS metadata_value, ism.ID AS metadata_id, MIN(ism.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY ism.`KEY` ORDER BY ism.`KEY`) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.UUID = ism.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.UUID = '0003c04d-211b-4847-8916-102efabca5bc') SELECT d.instance_id, d.display_name, d.user_id, d.project_id, d.vm_state, d.power_state, d.memory_mb, d.vcpus, d.availability_zone, d.metadata_key, d.metadata_value, d.metadata_id, d.window_column, s.metadata_count_range, s.metadata_count_variance, s.metadata_count_stddev FROM InstanceMetadataDetails AS d JOIN MetadataCountStatsByDisplayName AS s ON d.display_name = s.display_name ORDER BY d.display_name, d.metadata_key, d.metadata_id) SELECT ic.instance_id, ic.display_name, ic.user_id, ic.project_id, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.availability_zone, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_value, ic.metadata_id, ic.window_column, ic.metadata_count_range, ic.metadata_count_variance, ic.metadata_count_stddev, agg.total_vcpus_for_display_name, agg.total_memory_mb_for_display_name FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT i.display_name, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus_for_display_name, SUM(i.memory_mb) AS total_memory_mb_for_display_name FROM `instances` AS i WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name) AS agg ON ic.display_name = agg.display_name ORDER BY ic.display_name, ic.metadata_key, ic.metadata_id

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME, sg.DESCRIPTION, sg.USER_ID, sg.PROJECT_ID, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, sgr.TO_PORT, sgr.CIDR, MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) OVER (ORDER BY sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon'), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(FROM_PORT) AS avg_from_port FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.NAME, i.DESCRIPTION, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.PROTOCOL, i.FROM_PORT, i.TO_PORT, i.CIDR, i.window_column, (i.FROM_PORT - a.avg_from_port) AS deviation_from_avg_from_port FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, SUM(sgr.FROM_PORT) OVER (PARTITION BY sgr.PROTOCOL ORDER BY sgr.FROM_PORT) AS window_column FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon'), ProtocolAverages AS (SELECT sgr.PROTOCOL, AVG(sgr.FROM_PORT * 1.0) AS avg_from_port FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon' GROUP BY sgr.PROTOCOL) SELECT i.security_group_name, i.PROTOCOL, i.FROM_PORT, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ProtocolAverages AS pa ON pa.PROTOCOL = i.PROTOCOL WHERE i.FROM_PORT > pa.avg_from_port) SELECT q1.NAME AS security_group_name, q1.DESCRIPTION, q1.USER_ID, q1.PROJECT_ID, q1.PROTOCOL, q1.FROM_PORT, q1.TO_PORT, q1.CIDR, q1.window_column AS min_from_port_window_3_preceding_1_following, q1.deviation_from_avg_from_port, q2.window_column AS running_sum_from_ports_within_protocol FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.NAME = q2.security_group_name AND q1.PROTOCOL = q2.PROTOCOL AND q1.FROM_PORT = q2.FROM_PORT ORDER BY q1.PROTOCOL, q1.FROM_PORT

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MigrationStats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), Combined AS (SELECT fi.instance_id, fi.instance_uuid, fi.user_id, fi.project_id, fi.hostname, fi.vm_state, fi.power_state, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.availability_zone, fi.info_cache_id, fi.network_info, fi.window_column, ms.migration_status, ms.migration_count, ms.min_instance_memory_mb FROM ForgeInstances AS fi LEFT JOIN MigrationStats AS ms ON fi.vm_state = ms.instance_vm_state) SELECT * FROM Combined ORDER BY instance_id, migration_status), AverageMemory AS (SELECT AVG(memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.instance_id, ic.instance_uuid, ic.user_id, ic.project_id, ic.hostname, ic.vm_state, ic.power_state, ic.memory_mb, ic.vcpus, ic.availability_zone, ic.info_cache_id, ic.network_info, ic.window_column, ic.migration_status, ic.migration_count, ic.min_instance_memory_mb, (ic.memory_mb - am.avg_memory_mb) AS deviation_from_avg_memory_mb FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageMemory AS am ORDER BY ic.instance_id, ic.migration_status

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH mem_stats AS (SELECT i.display_name, VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_variance, STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS ic ON i.uuid = ic.instance_uuid WHERE ic.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC), meta_vcpu AS (SELECT i.uuid AS instance_uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone, COUNT(ism.id) AS metadata_entry_count, SUM(i.vcpus) AS total_vcpus FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY i.uuid, i.display_name, i.availability_zone), top10_by_variance AS (SELECT display_name, memory_mb_variance, memory_mb_stddev FROM mem_stats ORDER BY memory_mb_variance DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT t.display_name, t.memory_mb_variance, t.memory_mb_stddev, mv.instance_uuid, mv.availability_zone, mv.metadata_entry_count, mv.total_vcpus FROM top10_by_variance AS t JOIN meta_vcpu AS mv ON t.display_name = mv.display_name ORDER BY t.memory_mb_variance DESC) SELECT c.display_name, c.memory_mb_variance, c.memory_mb_stddev, c.instance_uuid, c.availability_zone, c.metadata_entry_count, c.total_vcpus, CASE WHEN i.config_drive IN ('True', 'true', '1', 1) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_config_drive FROM inner_cte AS c JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.uuid = c.instance_uuid ORDER BY c.memory_mb_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS (SELECT sg.NAME, MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) AS max_to_port, sgr.PROTOCOL FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME, sgr.PROTOCOL HAVING MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) > 1000), TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, MAX(sgr.FROM_PORT) - MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_range, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_range DESC) SELECT mtp.NAME AS security_group_name, mtp.PROTOCOL, mtp.max_to_port, tfs.from_port_range, tfs.from_port_variance FROM MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS mtp JOIN TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS tfs ON mtp.NAME = tfs.security_group_name ORDER BY mtp.max_to_port DESC), AvgOfMaxToPortsByProtocol AS (SELECT i.PROTOCOL, AVG(i.max_to_port * 1.0) AS avg_max_to_port FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.PROTOCOL) SELECT i.security_group_name, i.PROTOCOL, i.max_to_port, i.from_port_range, i.from_port_variance FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN AvgOfMaxToPortsByProtocol AS a ON a.PROTOCOL = i.PROTOCOL WHERE i.max_to_port > (SELECT a2.avg_max_to_port FROM AvgOfMaxToPortsByProtocol AS a2 WHERE a2.PROTOCOL = i.PROTOCOL) ORDER BY i.PROTOCOL, i.max_to_port DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS (SELECT sg.NAME, MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) AS max_to_port, sgr.PROTOCOL FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME, sgr.PROTOCOL HAVING MAX(sgr.TO_PORT) > 1000), TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, MAX(sgr.FROM_PORT) - MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_range, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_range DESC) SELECT mtp.NAME AS security_group_name, mtp.PROTOCOL, mtp.max_to_port, tfs.from_port_range, tfs.from_port_variance FROM MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS mtp JOIN TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS tfs ON mtp.NAME = tfs.security_group_name ORDER BY mtp.max_to_port DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(security_group_name) OVER (ORDER BY sg_sort, security_group_name, protocol) = security_group_name THEN NULL ELSE security_group_name END AS security_group_name, protocol, max_to_port, from_port_range, from_port_variance, qualifying_protocols FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.security_group_name END AS sg_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.security_group_name END AS security_group_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.PROTOCOL END AS protocol, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN MAX(i.max_to_port) ELSE i.max_to_port END AS max_to_port, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.from_port_range END AS from_port_range, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.from_port_variance END AS from_port_variance, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.security_group_name) = 1 THEN COUNT(*) ELSE NULL END AS qualifying_protocols FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.security_group_name, i.PROTOCOL, i.max_to_port, i.from_port_range, i.from_port_variance WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY sg_sort, security_group_name, protocol

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ForgeInstances AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge'), MigrationStats AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), Combined AS (SELECT fi.instance_id, fi.instance_uuid, fi.user_id, fi.project_id, fi.hostname, fi.vm_state, fi.power_state, fi.memory_mb, fi.vcpus, fi.availability_zone, fi.info_cache_id, fi.network_info, fi.window_column, ms.migration_status, ms.migration_count, ms.min_instance_memory_mb FROM ForgeInstances AS fi LEFT JOIN MigrationStats AS ms ON fi.vm_state = ms.instance_vm_state) SELECT * FROM Combined ORDER BY instance_id, migration_status), ProjectVmStateTotals AS (SELECT ic.project_id, ic.vm_state, SUM(ic.vcpus) AS total_vcpus_in_vm_state FROM inner_cte AS ic GROUP BY ic.project_id, ic.vm_state) SELECT project_id, MAX(total_vcpus_in_vm_state) AS max_total_vcpus_by_vm_state FROM ProjectVmStateTotals GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY project_id

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DaysToLaunchStats AS (SELECT i.display_name, AVG(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS avg_days_to_launch, STDDEV(i.launched_at - i.created_at) AS days_to_launch_stddev FROM `instance_extra` AS ie JOIN `instances` AS i ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'flare') GROUP BY i.display_name ORDER BY days_to_launch_stddev DESC), HostInstances AS (SELECT i.uuid, i.display_name, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, ie.flavor, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY i.project_id ORDER BY i.project_id) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.uuid = ie.instance_uuid WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT hi.display_name, dls.avg_days_to_launch, dls.days_to_launch_stddev, COUNT(DISTINCT hi.uuid) AS host_instance_count, AVG(hi.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb_on_host, AVG(hi.vcpus) AS avg_vcpus_on_host FROM HostInstances AS hi JOIN DaysToLaunchStats AS dls ON hi.display_name = dls.display_name GROUP BY hi.display_name, dls.avg_days_to_launch, dls.days_to_launch_stddev ORDER BY dls.days_to_launch_stddev DESC), PerProjectHostCounts AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.project_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.uuid) AS host_instances_in_project FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'flare') GROUP BY i.display_name, i.project_id) SELECT ic.display_name, ic.avg_days_to_launch, ic.days_to_launch_stddev, ic.host_instance_count, ic.avg_memory_mb_on_host, ic.avg_vcpus_on_host, MAX(pphc.host_instances_in_project) AS max_host_instance_count_in_any_project FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN PerProjectHostCounts AS pphc ON pphc.display_name = ic.display_name GROUP BY ic.display_name, ic.avg_days_to_launch, ic.days_to_launch_stddev, ic.host_instance_count, ic.avg_memory_mb_on_host, ic.avg_vcpus_on_host ORDER BY ic.days_to_launch_stddev DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH UsageReservationStats AS (SELECT q.ID AS usage_id, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE, COUNT(r.ID) AS reservation_count, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta FROM `quota_usages` AS q JOIN `reservations` AS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.IN_USE > 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY q.ID, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE), ResourceDeltaDispersion AS (SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS resource, VARIANCE(r.DELTA) AS delta_variance, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS delta_stddev FROM `quota_usages` AS qu JOIN `reservations` AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY delta_variance DESC) SELECT urs.usage_id, urs.PROJECT_ID, urs.RESOURCE, urs.reservation_count, urs.total_reserved_delta, rdd.delta_variance, rdd.delta_stddev, ROUND(urs.total_reserved_delta / NULLIF(urs.reservation_count, 0), 2) AS Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation FROM UsageReservationStats AS urs JOIN ResourceDeltaDispersion AS rdd ON urs.RESOURCE = rdd.resource ORDER BY rdd.delta_variance DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.RESOURCE) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE inner_cte.RESOURCE END AS resource, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.usage_id) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.RESOURCE) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(inner_cte.usage_id AS CHAR) END AS usage_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.usage_id) = 1 AND GROUPING(inner_cte.RESOURCE) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.RESOURCE) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.PROJECT_ID END AS project_id, SUM(inner_cte.reservation_count) AS reservation_count, SUM(inner_cte.total_reserved_delta) AS total_reserved_delta, MAX(inner_cte.delta_variance) AS delta_variance, MAX(inner_cte.delta_stddev) AS delta_stddev, ROUND(SUM(inner_cte.total_reserved_delta) / NULLIF(SUM(inner_cte.reservation_count), 0), 2) AS Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.RESOURCE, inner_cte.usage_id, inner_cte.PROJECT_ID WITH ROLLUP ORDER BY CASE WHEN GROUPING(inner_cte.RESOURCE) = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END, MAX(inner_cte.delta_variance) DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH UsageReservationStats AS (SELECT q.ID AS usage_id, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE, COUNT(r.ID) AS reservation_count, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta FROM `quota_usages` AS q JOIN `reservations` AS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.IN_USE > 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY q.ID, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE), ResourceDeltaDispersion AS (SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS resource, VARIANCE(r.DELTA) AS delta_variance, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS delta_stddev FROM `quota_usages` AS qu JOIN `reservations` AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY delta_variance DESC) SELECT urs.usage_id, urs.PROJECT_ID, urs.RESOURCE, urs.reservation_count, urs.total_reserved_delta, rdd.delta_variance, rdd.delta_stddev, ROUND(urs.total_reserved_delta / NULLIF(urs.reservation_count, 0), 2) AS Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation FROM UsageReservationStats AS urs JOIN ResourceDeltaDispersion AS rdd ON urs.RESOURCE = rdd.resource ORDER BY rdd.delta_variance DESC) SELECT i.usage_id, i.PROJECT_ID, i.RESOURCE, i.reservation_count, i.total_reserved_delta, i.delta_variance, i.delta_stddev, i.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `quota_usages` AS qu ON qu.ID = i.usage_id WHERE i.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation > (SELECT AVG(i2.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation * 1.0) FROM inner_cte AS i2 JOIN `quota_usages` AS qu2 ON qu2.ID = i2.usage_id) ORDER BY i.delta_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH migrations_completed_blaze AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, c.ID AS instance_info_cache_id, SUM(m.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY i.INSTANCE_TYPE_ID ORDER BY m.ID) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), memory_stddev_by_display_name AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, STDDEV(i.MEMORY_MB) AS memory_mb_stddev FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON i.UUID = iic.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY memory_mb_stddev DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_migrations_on_blaze8_12_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ms.DISPLAY_NAME) AS display_names_with_memory_stddev_count FROM migrations_completed_blaze AS mcb LEFT JOIN memory_stddev_by_display_name AS ms ON ms.DISPLAY_NAME = mcb.instance_display_name) SELECT inner_cte.completed_migrations_on_blaze8_12_count, inner_cte.display_names_with_memory_stddev_count FROM inner_cte JOIN `migrations` AS m ON m.STATUS = 'completed' JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12' JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON c.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH UsageReservationStats AS (SELECT q.ID AS usage_id, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE, COUNT(r.ID) AS reservation_count, SUM(r.DELTA) AS total_reserved_delta FROM `quota_usages` AS q JOIN `reservations` AS r ON q.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE q.IN_USE > 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY q.ID, q.PROJECT_ID, q.RESOURCE), ResourceDeltaDispersion AS (SELECT qu.RESOURCE AS resource, VARIANCE(r.DELTA) AS delta_variance, STDDEV(r.DELTA) AS delta_stddev FROM `quota_usages` AS qu JOIN `reservations` AS r ON qu.ID = r.USAGE_ID WHERE qu.DELETED = 0 AND r.EXPIRE < '2021-11-16 19:30:59' GROUP BY qu.RESOURCE ORDER BY delta_variance DESC) SELECT urs.usage_id, urs.PROJECT_ID, urs.RESOURCE, urs.reservation_count, urs.total_reserved_delta, rdd.delta_variance, rdd.delta_stddev, ROUND(urs.total_reserved_delta / NULLIF(urs.reservation_count, 0), 2) AS Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation FROM UsageReservationStats AS urs JOIN ResourceDeltaDispersion AS rdd ON urs.RESOURCE = rdd.resource ORDER BY rdd.delta_variance DESC), Benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation) AS benchmark_avg_reserved_delta_per_reservation FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.usage_id, i.PROJECT_ID, i.RESOURCE, i.reservation_count, i.total_reserved_delta, i.delta_variance, i.delta_stddev, i.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation, b.benchmark_avg_reserved_delta_per_reservation AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation > b.benchmark_avg_reserved_delta_per_reservation * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_AVG_DELTA' WHEN i.Avg_Reserved_Delta_Per_Reservation < b.benchmark_avg_reserved_delta_per_reservation * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_AVG_DELTA' ELSE 'AVERAGE_AVG_DELTA' END AS avg_delta_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN Benchmark AS b ORDER BY i.delta_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH sq1 AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(m.memory_total) AS memory_total_stddev FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.display_name, 'prime') GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING COUNT(ism.id) > 1 ORDER BY memory_total_stddev DESC), sq2 AS (SELECT i.display_name, STDDEV(i.root_gb) / NULLIF(AVG(i.root_gb), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'blaze8-12' GROUP BY i.display_name HAVING AVG(i.root_gb) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT sq1.display_name, sq1.memory_total_stddev, sq2.coefficient_of_variation FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq1.display_name = sq2.display_name ORDER BY sq1.memory_total_stddev DESC) SELECT inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_total_stddev, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, STDDEV(m.disk_total) AS disk_total_stddev FROM inner_cte JOIN `instances` AS i ON i.display_name = inner_cte.display_name JOIN `migrations` AS m ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid GROUP BY inner_cte.display_name, inner_cte.memory_total_stddev, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.memory_total_stddev DESC

WITH MigrationCompleted AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed'), InstanceMetadataWindow AS (SELECT i.display_name, i.availability_zone, i.vm_state, i.memory_mb, i.vcpus, i.uuid, MAX(ism.id) OVER (ORDER BY i.uuid ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_metadata_id_next_2 FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3') SELECT mc.instance_uuid, mc.instance_display_name, imw.availability_zone, imw.vm_state, imw.memory_mb, imw.vcpus, mc.instance_hostname, mc.migration_source_compute, mc.migration_dest_compute, mc.migration_dest_host, mc.migration_type, mc.memory_total, mc.memory_processed, mc.memory_remaining, mc.window_column AS min_memory_remaining_per_instance_uuid, imw.max_metadata_id_next_2, ROUND(mc.memory_processed / NULLIF(mc.memory_total, 0), 4) AS memory_processed_ratio FROM MigrationCompleted AS mc JOIN InstanceMetadataWindow AS imw ON imw.uuid = mc.instance_uuid ORDER BY memory_processed_ratio DESC

WITH q1 AS (SELECT m.status AS migration_status, i.vm_state AS instance_vm_state, COUNT(m.id) AS migration_count, MIN(i.memory_mb) AS min_instance_memory_mb FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type' GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state), q2 AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, m.STATUS AS migration_status, COUNT(i.ID) AS instance_count, MIN(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS min_memory_total FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.HIDDEN = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE, m.STATUS) SELECT q1.migration_status, q1.instance_vm_state, q1.migration_count, q1.min_instance_memory_mb, q2.instance_count, q2.min_memory_total FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.migration_status = q2.migration_status AND q1.instance_vm_state = q2.vm_state ORDER BY q1.migration_count DESC

WITH VMStateMigrationMemoryVariance AS (SELECT i.VM_STATE, VARIANCE(m.MEMORY_TOTAL) AS memory_total_variance FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY i.VM_STATE ORDER BY memory_total_variance DESC), ForgeInstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.ID AS instance_id, i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.USER_ID, i.PROJECT_ID, i.HOSTNAME, i.VM_STATE, i.POWER_STATE, i.MEMORY_MB, i.VCPUS, i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, c.ID AS info_cache_id, c.NETWORK_INFO, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.PROJECT_ID ORDER BY i.PROJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS c ON i.UUID = c.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE i.DISPLAY_NAME = 'forge') SELECT fid.instance_id, fid.instance_uuid, fid.USER_ID, fid.PROJECT_ID, fid.HOSTNAME, fid.VM_STATE, fid.POWER_STATE, fid.MEMORY_MB, fid.VCPUS, fid.AVAILABILITY_ZONE, fid.info_cache_id, fid.NETWORK_INFO, fid.window_column AS min_memory_mb_in_project, vmmv.memory_total_variance FROM ForgeInstanceDetails AS fid JOIN VMStateMigrationMemoryVariance AS vmmv ON fid.VM_STATE = vmmv.VM_STATE ORDER BY vmmv.memory_total_variance DESC, fid.PROJECT_ID, fid.instance_id

WITH RuleWindow AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, SUM(sgr.FROM_PORT) OVER (PARTITION BY sgr.PROTOCOL ORDER BY sgr.FROM_PORT) AS window_column FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon'), TopRuleCounts AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, COUNT(sgr.ID) AS rule_count FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.DELETED = 0 AND sgr.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY rule_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT rw.security_group_name, rw.PROTOCOL, rw.FROM_PORT, rw.window_column, trc.rule_count, ROUND(rw.window_column / NULLIF(trc.rule_count, 0), 2) AS normalized_running_from_port_per_rule FROM RuleWindow AS rw JOIN TopRuleCounts AS trc ON rw.security_group_name = trc.security_group_name ORDER BY normalized_running_from_port_per_rule DESC, rw.PROTOCOL, rw.FROM_PORT

WITH TcpRuleStats AS (SELECT sg.ID AS security_group_id, sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sg.DESCRIPTION AS security_group_description, COUNT(sgr.ID) AS rule_count, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT) AS total_to_port FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.ID, sg.NAME, sg.DESCRIPTION), GeoMeanPortRange AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, EXP(AVG(LN(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1))) AS geometric_mean_port_range_size FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.TO_PORT >= sgr.FROM_PORT GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_port_range_size DESC), CombinedSecurityGroupMetrics AS (SELECT t.security_group_id, t.security_group_name, t.security_group_description, t.rule_count, t.total_to_port, g.geometric_mean_port_range_size FROM TcpRuleStats AS t JOIN GeoMeanPortRange AS g ON t.security_group_name = g.security_group_name) SELECT security_group_id, security_group_name, security_group_description, rule_count, total_to_port, geometric_mean_port_range_size FROM CombinedSecurityGroupMetrics ORDER BY security_group_name

WITH RuleWindow AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, sgr.TO_PORT, sgr.CIDR, AVG(sgr.FROM_PORT) OVER (PARTITION BY sgr.PROTOCOL ORDER BY sgr.FROM_PORT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sg.NAME = 'aurum-xenon' ORDER BY sgr.FROM_PORT), TcpPortCoverage AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) AS total_ports_covered FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME HAVING SUM(sgr.TO_PORT - sgr.FROM_PORT + 1) > 100) SELECT rw.security_group_name, rw.PROTOCOL, rw.FROM_PORT, rw.TO_PORT, rw.CIDR, rw.window_column AS avg_from_port_window_2_pre_2_fol, tpc.total_ports_covered, ROUND(rw.window_column / NULLIF(tpc.total_ports_covered, 0), 6) AS normalized_window_avg_to_total_ports_ratio FROM RuleWindow AS rw JOIN TcpPortCoverage AS tpc ON rw.security_group_name = tpc.security_group_name WHERE rw.security_group_name = 'aurum-xenon' ORDER BY normalized_window_avg_to_total_ports_ratio DESC, rw.FROM_PORT

WITH sg_tcp_from_port_variability_rollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME AS security_group_name, MAX(sgr.FROM_PORT) - MIN(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_range, VARIANCE(sgr.FROM_PORT) AS from_port_variance FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.PROTOCOL = 'tcp' GROUP BY sg.NAME ORDER BY from_port_range DESC), RangeStatus AS (SELECT security_group_name, CASE WHEN from_port_range >= 1000 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Low' END AS variability_status, COUNT(*) AS total_security_groups FROM inner_cte GROUP BY security_group_name, variability_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(security_group_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE security_group_name END AS security_group_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(variability_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(security_group_name) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE variability_status END AS variability_status, SUM(total_security_groups) AS total_security_groups FROM RangeStatus GROUP BY security_group_name, variability_status WITH ROLLUP), sg_rule_details_with_max_next_2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sg.NAME, sgr.PROTOCOL, sgr.FROM_PORT, sgr.TO_PORT, sgr.CIDR, sgr.ID AS RULE_ID, MAX(sg.ID) OVER (ORDER BY sgr.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_GROUP_ID_NEXT_2 FROM `security_groups` AS sg JOIN `security_group_rules` AS sgr ON sg.ID = sgr.PARENT_GROUP_ID WHERE sgr.DELETED = 0) SELECT i.NAME, i.PROTOCOL, i.FROM_PORT, i.TO_PORT, i.CIDR, i.RULE_ID, i.MAX_GROUP_ID_NEXT_2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `security_groups` AS sg2 ON sg2.NAME = i.NAME WHERE sg2.DELETED = 0 AND sg2.ID > (SELECT AVG(sg3.ID) * 1.0 FROM `security_groups` AS sg3 WHERE sg3.DELETED = 0)) SELECT v.security_group_name, v.variability_status, v.total_security_groups, COUNT(r.RULE_ID) AS qualifying_rule_count FROM sg_tcp_from_port_variability_rollup AS v LEFT JOIN sg_rule_details_with_max_next_2 AS r ON r.NAME = v.security_group_name GROUP BY v.security_group_name, v.variability_status, v.total_security_groups ORDER BY v.security_group_name, v.variability_status

WITH MigrationDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.HOSTNAME AS instance_hostname, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE AS migration_source_compute, m.DEST_COMPUTE AS migration_dest_compute, m.DEST_HOST AS migration_dest_host, m.MIGRATION_TYPE AS migration_type, m.MEMORY_TOTAL AS memory_total, m.MEMORY_PROCESSED AS memory_processed, m.MEMORY_REMAINING AS memory_remaining, MIN(m.MEMORY_REMAINING) OVER (PARTITION BY m.INSTANCE_UUID ORDER BY m.INSTANCE_UUID) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `migrations` AS m ON i.UUID = m.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), ImageTypeMetadataAndNetwork AS (SELECT t1.DISPLAY_NAME, t0.VALUE AS metadata_value, t2.NETWORK_INFO, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.VALUE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `instance_system_metadata` AS t0 JOIN `instances` AS t1 ON t0.INSTANCE_UUID = t1.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS t2 ON t1.UUID = t2.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE t0.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND t1.host = 'blaze8-12') SELECT md.instance_uuid, md.instance_display_name, md.instance_hostname, md.migration_source_compute, md.migration_dest_compute, md.migration_dest_host, md.migration_type, md.memory_total, md.memory_processed, md.memory_remaining, md.window_column AS min_memory_remaining_within_instance_uuid, imn.metadata_value, imn.NETWORK_INFO, imn.window_column AS metadata_value_row_number_window FROM MigrationDetails AS md JOIN ImageTypeMetadataAndNetwork AS imn ON md.instance_display_name = imn.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY md.instance_uuid, imn.metadata_value

WITH InstanceDetails AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.HOSTNAME AS hostname, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.FLAVOR AS flavor_json, ie.NUMA_TOPOLOGY AS numa_topology_json, iic.NETWORK_INFO AS network_info_json, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (PARTITION BY i.VCPUS ORDER BY i.VCPUS) AS window_column FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')), CompletedMigrations AS (SELECT m.ID AS migration_id, m.STATUS AS migration_status, m.SOURCE_COMPUTE, m.DEST_COMPUTE, m.INSTANCE_UUID, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS instance_display_name, i.MEMORY_MB AS instance_memory_mb, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MIN(i.MEMORY_MB) OVER (ORDER BY m.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `migrations` AS m JOIN `instances` AS i ON m.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON i.UUID = ie.INSTANCE_UUID WHERE m.STATUS = 'completed' AND REGEXP_LIKE(i.DISPLAY_NAME, 'flare')) SELECT id.instance_uuid, id.hostname, id.display_name, id.memory_mb, id.vcpus, id.flavor_json, id.numa_topology_json, id.network_info_json, id.window_column AS min_memory_mb_within_vcpu_count, cm.migration_id, cm.migration_status, cm.SOURCE_COMPUTE, cm.DEST_COMPUTE, cm.instance_extra_id, cm.window_column AS min_instance_memory_mb_in_migration_window FROM InstanceDetails AS id JOIN CompletedMigrations AS cm ON cm.INSTANCE_UUID = id.instance_uuid

WITH RootGBStatsByDisplayName AS (SELECT i.DISPLAY_NAME, MAX(i.ROOT_GB) - MIN(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_range, VARIANCE(i.ROOT_GB) AS root_gb_variance FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_system_metadata` AS ism ON ism.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE ism.`KEY` = 'image_image_type' AND i.host = 'prime-35' GROUP BY i.DISPLAY_NAME ORDER BY root_gb_range DESC), InstanceDetailsFlare3Blaze AS (SELECT i.UUID AS instance_uuid, i.DISPLAY_NAME AS display_name, i.VM_STATE AS vm_state, i.POWER_STATE AS power_state, i.MEMORY_MB AS memory_mb, i.VCPUS AS vcpus, ie.ID AS instance_extra_id, MAX(i.ID) OVER (ORDER BY i.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_instance_id_next_2 FROM `instances` AS i JOIN `instance_extra` AS ie ON ie.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID JOIN `instance_info_caches` AS iic ON iic.INSTANCE_UUID = i.UUID WHERE i.DELETED = 0 AND i.AVAILABILITY_ZONE = 'flare3' AND i.HOST = 'blaze8-12'), CombinedInstanceView AS (SELECT idfb.instance_uuid, idfb.display_name, idfb.vm_state, idfb.power_state, idfb.memory_mb, idfb.vcpus, idfb.instance_extra_id, idfb.max_instance_id_next_2, rgb.root_gb_range, rgb.root_gb_variance FROM InstanceDetailsFlare3Blaze AS idfb LEFT JOIN RootGBStatsByDisplayName AS rgb ON rgb.DISPLAY_NAME = idfb.display_name) SELECT * FROM CombinedInstanceView ORDER BY instance_uuid
